doc.title: Steve Gilmore interviewed by Monk Rowe, Delaware Water Gap, PA, November 8, 1999

title: Local playing: Bill Washer, Bill Charlap, Deerhead Inn
summary: He works little locally apart from Bill Washer, duo gigs with Bill Charlap and the Deerhead Inn.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: In your playing these days, do you have a circle in this particular area that you usually go to as far as traveling?
You mean musicians I play with in this area?

There’s not too many musicians I play with in this area other than Phil, actually very little in this particular area. There’s very little work. But I did work, there was a little gig, a jazz trio guitar gig that I worked last night with a wonderful guitarist, Bill Washer, who lives in this area. And other than that, I work here at the Deerhead Inn. But generally I don’t work with people who live in the area. Bill Charlap and I, the wonderful pianist with Phil Woods at this particular time, have a duo and work together as a duo whenever we can and so we work here. And I work here with other people too sometimes.
